positions.name: PallasineChecklistAsCurrentAuthority
positions.frame: what establishes the Pallasine checklist as the operative, authoritative onboarding process rather than a leftover or optional artifact?
positions.why: src-1 states the checklist as a universal, present-tense mandate every new hire completes; src-2 supplies its provenance, that it superseded the old wiki page last quarter. Read together, the two expressions jointly ground the checklist's current legitimacy — one asserts what it now requires, the other asserts why it, and not the prior artifact, is the operative reference. No tension: both push the same direction, establishing standing rather than describing content in isolation.
